RPBroadcastActivityController.doc: A controller object that presents the macOS broadcast picker.

RPBroadcastController.doc: An object containing methods for starting and controlling a broadcast.

RPBroadcastHandler.doc: An object that sends messages to the broadcasting app.

RPBroadcastSampleHandler.doc: An object that processes buffer objects as received from ReplayKit.

RPPreviewViewController.doc: An object that displays a user interface where users preview and edit a screen recording that you create with ReplayKit.

RPScreenRecorder.doc: The shared recorder object that provides the ability to record audio and video of your app.

RPBroadcastActivityControllerDelegate.doc: A protocol that defines the methods to implement to respond to selection events from a broadcast activity controller.

RPBroadcastActivityViewControllerDelegat.doc: The protocol you implement to respond to changes to a broadcast activity user interface.

RPBroadcastControllerDelegate.doc: The protocol you implement to respond to changes in a live broadcast.

RPPreviewViewControllerDelegate.doc: The protocol you implement to respond to changes to a screen-recording user interface.

RPScreenRecorderDelegate.doc: The protocol you implement to receive notifications from the screen recorder.

RPCameraPosition.doc: The position of the camera being accessed.

RPRecordingErrorActivePhoneCall.doc: Unable to record due to an active phone call.

RPRecordingErrorAttemptToStartInRecordin.doc: Attempted to start a recording that’s already in a recording state.

RPRecordingErrorAttemptToStopNonRecordin.doc: Attempted to stop a recording that’s not in a recording state.

RPRecordingErrorBroadcastInvalidSession.doc: Attempted to start a broadcast without a prior session.

RPRecordingErrorCarPlay.doc: Failed to start recording because CarPlay is active.

RPRecordingErrorCodeSuccessful.doc: Successfully saved the recording to the Camera Roll.

RPRecordingErrorContentResize.doc: Recording interrupted by multitasking and content resizing.

RPRecordingErrorEntitlements.doc: Recording failed due to missing entitlements.

RPRecordingErrorFailedApplicationConnect.doc: The recording failed because the app’s connection was interrupted.
The recording failed because the app’s connection is invalid.

RPRecordingErrorFailedAssetWriterExportC.doc: The recording failed because the user canceled the export.

RPRecordingErrorFailedAssetWriterExportF.doc: The recording failed due to an error exporting the movie.

RPRecordingErrorFailedAssetWriterFailedT.doc: The recording failed due to an asset writer failure.

RPRecordingErrorFailedAssetWriterInWrong.doc: The recording failed because the asset writer is in an invalid state.

RPRecordingErrorFailedIncorrectTimeStamp.doc: The recording failed due to malformed start and end time intervals.

RPRecordingErrorFailedMediaServicesFailu.doc: The recording failed due to a mediaservices daemon failure.

RPRecordingErrorFailedNoAssetWriter.doc: The recording failed because there is no asset writer available.

RPRecordingErrorFailedNoMatchingApplicat.doc: The context identifier doesn’t match the app identifier.

RPRecordingErrorFailedToObtainURL.doc: The recording failed due to a failure to obtain the URL.

RPRecordingErrorFailedToProcessFirstSamp.doc: The recording failed because the asset writer failed to process the first media sample.

RPRecordingErrorFailedToRemoveFile.doc: The recording failed because the temporary file wasn’t removed.

RPRecordingErrorFailedToStartCaptureStac.doc: The system failed to configure the app for A/V recording.

RPRecordingErrorFilePermissions.doc: The recording failed due to a file permission error.

RPRecordingErrorInsufficientStorage.doc: Not enough storage available on the device.

RPRecordingErrorInvalidParameter.doc: The recording failed because of an invalid parameter.

RPRecordingErrorPhotoFailure.doc: Failed saving the video the Camera Roll.

RPRecordingErrorRecordingInvalidSession.doc: Attempted to start an invalid recording session.

RPRecordingErrorSystemDormancy.doc: Recording forced to end by the user pressing the power button.

RPRecordingErrorVideoMixingFailure.doc: The recording failed due to an A/V mixing failure.

RPSampleBufferType.doc: The type of media clip sample being buffered.

RPSampleBufferTypeAudioApp.doc: The sample audio that originates from the app.

RPSampleBufferTypeAudioMic.doc: The sample audio that originates from the microphone.

RPSampleBufferTypeVideo.doc: The sample that contains a video clip.

+showBroadcastPickerAtPoint:fromWindow:p.doc: Presents a list of available broadcast services for the user to select.

-updateBroadcastURL:.doc: Sends the current broadcast URL to the broadcast controller.

-updateServiceInfo:.doc: Sends information about the current broadcast to the broadcasting app.

-broadcastAnnotatedWithApplicationInfo:.doc: Perform any required actions after starting a live broadcast.

-broadcastFinished.doc: Perform any required actions after a live broadcast is finished.

-broadcastPaused.doc: Perform any required actions after a live broadcast is paused.

-broadcastResumed.doc: Perform any required actions after a live broadcast is resumed.

-broadcastStartedWithSetupInfo:.doc: Perform any required actions after starting a live broadcast.

-finishBroadcastWithError:.doc: Stops the broadcast and passes an error back to the broadcasting app.

-processSampleBuffer:withType:.doc: Processes video and audio data as it becomes available during a live broadcast.

+sharedRecorder.doc: Returns an app’s instance of the shared screen recorder.

-exportClipToURL:duration:completionHand.doc: Exports a clip recording to a file.

-startRecordingWithMicrophoneEnabled:han.doc: Starts recording the app’s audio and video.

-stopRecordingWithOutputURL:completionHa.doc: Stops the current recording and writes the movie to the specified output URL.

delegate.doc: The broadcast activity controller’s delegate object.

broadcastExtensionBundleID.doc: The bundle ID for the selected broadcast service.

broadcastURL.doc: A URL that redirects users to an ongoing or completed broadcast.

broadcasting.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the controller is broadcasting.

delegate.doc: The delegate for the broadcast controller.

paused.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the broadcast is paused.

serviceInfo.doc: Information updated by the service during a broadcast.

mode.doc: The type of screen that appears when the view is presented.

available.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the screen recorder is available for recording.

cameraEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the camera is currently enabled.

cameraPreviewView.doc: A view containing the contents of the front-facing camera.

delegate.doc: The delegate for the screen recorder.

microphoneEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the microphone is currently enabled.

recording.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the app is currently recording.
